title: Request for Expression of Interest (EOI) from prospective bidders for Integration of Vessel Traffic Management System at all Major Ports on Turn Key Basis
summary: Expression of Interest, with budgetary offers, for integrating the Vessel Traffic Management Systems of India's 12 major ports (and a planned VTMS at Port Blair) into DGLL's National Data Centre, Mumbai over the NAIS network, on a turnkey basis.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships, A-13 Deep Bhavan, Sector-24, Noida

sites.name: Kolkata Port/Haldia, West Bengal
sites.work: VTMS integration; connect to RCC Kolkata (Directorate office)

sites.name: Paradip Port, Orissa
sites.work: VTMS integration; connect to NAIS site Paradip LH

sites.work: VTMS integration; connect to RCC Visakhapatnam at Dolphin Nose LH

sites.work: VTMS integration; connect to RCC Chennai (Directorate office)

sites.name: National Data Centre (NDC), Mumbai
sites.work: Central integration point; feed to NMDA Centre and DG Shipping MM-DAC

scope.item: Interface units (hardware and software) with IT infrastructure at each of 12 major ports and 01 VTMS at Port Blair to ensure IVEF compatibility
Uninterrupted, redundant connectivity from port VTMS to DGLL NDC Mumbai via nearest NAIS Physical Shore Station/RCC
Integrated VTMS feed to NMDA Centre and Mercantile Marine Domain Awareness Center (MM-DAC) of DG Shipping
Web-based VTMS feed to user agencies
Provision for integration of coastal VTMS in Gulf of Khambhat and other VTMSs
Warranty 3 years and CAMC 7 years for all items/systems (budgetary rates, sites with and without IVEF)

money.notes: No estimate, EMD or fee. Bidders to submit budgetary offer in prescribed format (Indian and foreign components, GST, customs duty, communication links, 7-year CAMC).

period.warranty: 3 years warranty plus 7 years CAMC; spares and software upgrades from OEM assured for 10 years

eligibility: Prospective bidders of repute having exposure on the subject work
Details of VTS developed, supplied, operated and maintained in last seven years (Appendix 2) with annual turnover of last three years
Organisational structure and legal status (Appendix 1); letter of transmittal on firm letterhead
specs: IVEF (Inter VTMS Exchange Format) per IALA; solution per IALA/IMO standards
VTMS governed by SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 12 and IMO Resolution A.1158(32)
Data transfer over DGLL NAIS network; bidders to submit network diagram and communication options with pros and cons
notes: Non-binding EOI. Queries by 16.11.2023; pre-bid meeting (physical and virtual) 17.11.2023 15:00 at Deep Bhavan, Noida; EOI submission in writing by 30.11.2023 16:00. Section II says information received from the 12 major ports (existing VTMS equipment, OEMs) is enclosed as Annexure-I, but Annexure-I only lists each port's nearest NAIS site/RCC. Prep listed 12 pages but PDF has 13; pages 10, 12, 13 are blank (page 10 and 12 images confirmed empty). Office landline/e-mail printed (noida-dgll@nic.in).
